queries.title: Search topics
queries.description: Topics, brands, companies or phrases to monitor, one per line ("supply chain", "Tesla recall"). Wrap multi-word phrases in quotes for an exact match ("\"electric vehicle\""). Each runs its own search.

mode.title: What to return
mode.description: Articles = a list of matching news articles. Coverage timeline = how much of world news coverage mentioned the topic over time (great for spotting spikes).

timespanDays.title: Look back (days)
timespanDays.description: How many days back to search. GDELT covers a rolling window; recent days have the fullest coverage.

sourceCountry.title: Source country
sourceCountry.description: Optional: limit to media from one country, using GDELT's country name with no spaces ("UnitedStates", "UnitedKingdom", "Kenya", "Germany"). Leave empty for worldwide.

language.title: Language
language.description: Optional: limit to one language ("English", "Spanish", "French", "German"). Leave empty for all languages.

advancedFilters.title: Advanced GDELT filters
advancedFilters.description: Optional: extra GDELT query operators appended to every search, e.g. "tone<-5" (negative coverage) or "domainis:bbc.co.uk". For power users; see the GDELT DOC 2.0 documentation.

maxPerQuery.title: Articles per topic
maxPerQuery.description: Articles mode only: how many articles to return per topic (GDELT returns up to 250 most recent).

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
